title: Ring Fit Adventure
subtitle: An adventure moved by exercise
summary: Ring Fit Adventure is Nintendo's exercise role-playing game, released for Switch on 18 October 2019.
body: Ring Fit Adventure is Nintendo's exercise role-playing game, released for Switch on 18 October 2019. The player advances through a fantasy adventure by performing physical activities, using a flexible Ring-Con held in the hands and a strap attached to the leg. Jogging and exercises move the journey forward, while battles turn selected movements into actions against enemies. The structure supplies a destination and a next challenge, connecting a session of repeated physical effort to the continuing progress of a character and a world.

One Joy-Con fits into the Ring-Con and another into the Leg Strap. Motion sensing reads the player's movement, while the ring measures how it is pressed or pulled. The accessories make different exercises legible to the game and let those actions serve as controls. A battle becomes a sequence of chosen activities performed and measured, rather than commands selected without movement. The physical resistance of the ring supplies feedback that an ordinary button cannot, linking the action on screen to effort felt in the player's hands.

Alongside the adventure, guided routines and shorter minigames provide other ways to use the equipment. This variety allows a session to focus on a particular activity or continue the larger role-playing journey. Nintendo developed the project within its interest in games that support everyday activity, following the broader path established by Wii Fit. Ring Fit gives that aim an equipment-based identity of its own: the ring and strap remain simple objects, while the software turns their movement into a reason to return for another session.
story_headings: A ring and a strap become the controller
